title: auth/config: UserCredential missing Clone
description: crates/auth/src/config.rs — UserCredential derives Debug and Deserialize but not Clone. All sibling types (ClientCertEntry, TrustedIssuerEntry, OidcProviderConfig) derive Clone. Callers that need to copy a credential list (e.g. arc-cloning config) will hit a compilation error. Missing Clone forces gratuitous Arc wrapping or repeated deserialization.
